answer: Histories are stored in canyon, checked in cedar, and vertex reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 11 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 882 identities would post 1401 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
